name: Maviston Mai Khao
shortDescription: A condominium in Mai Khao with one to three bedroom units, developed by Mai Khao Golden Beach.
description:
Maviston Mai Khao is a condominium in Mai Khao, on Phuket's northwest coast, with one to three bedroom units according to agent listings. Agents name Mai Khao Golden Beach as the developer.

It is a condominium, not a villa project. Completion is quoted anywhere between 2026 and Q4 2027, so ask us for the current construction status. Some agents advertise rental guarantees of 6 or 7%; we have not verified any of them and do not repeat them as an offer.

Prices start from roughly 9 million baht in agent listings. Message us on WhatsApp for the price list.
